name: sketchy
description: Explains things visually: hand-drawn, interactive diagrams, circuits and labeled photos right in the chat.
long_description:
Sketchy lets Claude draw while it explains. Claude decides what to show; Sketchy lays it out and renders it in a consistent hand-drawn style inside the chat.

Drawings currently appear in Claude Code sessions (Code tab); support for the regular chat is planned.

- Architecture diagrams of your code; click a box to open the file
- Step-by-step walkthroughs that highlight one part at a time
- Wiring diagrams for Arduino sketches with real part drawings
- Freely licensed photos labeled by a local vision model, with attribution
- Export as SVG or PNG
